fusions.name: Trotting Snapshot
fusions.desc: Fires a quick round that deals 5 damage, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Cavalry Burst
fusions.desc: You ride up to 7 tiles at the target, then fire a cone of shot ahead of you, dealing 13 damage to everything caught in it.

fusions.name: Mounted Fire
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 20% for 10 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 8 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Second Mount
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
